Importing data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(terra)
library(ausflora)
library(performance)

xylem_areas <- list.files("area_data/", full.names = T) |> 
  map_df(read.csv, header = T) |> 
  separate(Image, c("family", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |> 
  separate(other, c("species", "state", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") |> 
  mutate(area_mm = Area.µm.2/1000000,
         radius = sqrt(Area.µm.2/pi))

resources <- load_taxonomic_resources()

namematched <- create_taxonomic_update_lookup(xylem_areas$species, 
                                                     resources = resources)
xylem_areas <- xylem_areas |> left_join(namematched[,c(1,3)], by = c("species" = "original_name"))
```


Zanne et al. (2010) comparison
```{r}
zanne_data <- read.csv("data/zanne_data.csv", header = T)
zanne_native <- native_anywhere_in_australia(zanne_data$Binomial, 
                                             resources = resources) |> 
  right_join(zanne_data, by = c("species" = "Binomial")) |> 
  filter(native_anywhere_in_aus == "TRUE" )

jugo_data <- xylem_areas |> 
  group_by(species) |> 
  mutate(total_area = sum(area_mm, na.rm=T)) |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel") |> 
  group_by(species) |> 
  summarise(n=n(),
         mean_area = mean(area_mm, na.rm=T),
         log_mean_area = log(mean_area),
         sd_area = sd(log(area_mm)),
         n_per_area = n/total_area,
         area_n_ratio = mean_area/n_per_area) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  left_join(xylem_areas[, c(1:2)], by = "species") |> 
  distinct()

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = zanne_data, aes(x = N, y = A), col = "light grey") +
  # geom_point(data = zanne_native, aes(x = N, y = A), col = "black") +
  geom_point(data = jugo_data, aes(x = n_per_area, y = mean_area, col = family)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~family)
```


Creating climate preference data
```{r}
occurrences <- list.files("occurrences/", full.names = T)
occurrence_data <- occurrences |> map_df(read.csv, header = T) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  rename(species = scientificName)

ala_namematch <- create_taxonomic_update_lookup(occurrence_data$species, 
                                                 resources = resources)
occurrence_data <- occurrence_data |> 
  left_join(ala_namematch[,c(1,3)], by = c("species" = "original_name"))

occurrence_points <- vect(occurrence_data, geom = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"))

raster_list <- list.files("rasters_30s/", full.names = T) |> map(rast)

for (raster in raster_list) {
  occurrence_data <- occurrence_data |> 
    mutate(!!sym(names(raster)) := terra::extract(raster, occurrence_points)[[2]])
}

climate_preferences <- occurrence_data |> 
  group_by(apc_name) |>  
  summarise(mean_MAP=mean(MAP, na.rm=T), 
            tenth_MAP=quantile(MAP, c(0.1, 0.9), na.rm=T)[1],
            sd_log_MAP=sd(log(MAP), na.rm=T),
            MAT=mean(MAT, na.rm=T),
            seasonality=mean(seasonality, na.rm=T),
            wet_quarter=mean(wet_quarter, na.rm=T),
            dry_quarter=mean(dry_quarter, na.rm=T),
            AI=mean(awi_pm_sr_yr/10000, na.rm=T),
            n=n()) |> 
  mutate(climate=cut(AI, breaks=c(-Inf, 0.03, 0.2, 0.5, 0.65, Inf), 
                     labels=c("Hyper Arid", "Arid", "Semi-Arid", "Dry sub-humid", "Humid"))) |> 
  filter(n > 5) |> 
  filter(apc_name %in% namematched$apc_name) |>
  # left_join(xylem_areas[c("family", "apc_name")], by = c("species" = "apc_name")) |> 
  distinct()
  
write.csv(climate_preferences, "data/climate_preferences.csv", row.names = F)
```


Hydraulically weighted diameter (Dh)
```{r}
climate_preferences <- read.csv("data/climate_preferences.csv", header = T)

xylem_Dh <- xylem_areas |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel") |>
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  summarise(sample_Dh = sum(radius^5)/ sum(radius^4)) |> 
  group_by(apc_name) |> 
  summarise(mean_Dh = mean(sample_Dh, na.rm=T)) |> 
  left_join(climate_preferences, by = "apc_name") |> 
  left_join(xylem_areas[,c("family", "apc_name")], by = "apc_name") |> 
  distinct() |> 
  drop_na()

ggplot(data = xylem_Dh, aes(x = mean_MAP, y = mean_Dh, col = family)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")

Dh_lm <- lm(log(mean_Dh)~log(mean_MAP), data = xylem_Dh
            # |> filter(family != "CASUARINACEAE")
            )
# check_model(Dh_lm)
summary(Dh_lm)
# r2(Dh_lm)

Dh_aov <- lm(log(mean_Dh)~log(mean_MAP)+family, data = xylem_Dh)
summary(Dh_aov)
# check_model(Dh_aov)
# r2(Dh_aov)
```

MDS plot
```{r}
library(vegan)

xylem_properties <- xylem_Dh[2:6] |> log()
xylem_properties.mds <- metaMDS(comm = xylem_properties, 
                                distance = "bray", 
                                trace = F, 
                                autotransform = F)

MDS_xy <- data.frame(xylem_properties.mds$points)
MDS_xy$family <- xylem_Dh$family

ggplot(MDS_xy, aes(MDS1, MDS2, col = family)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic()

xylem_PCA <- princomp(xylem_properties, cor = F)
biplot(xylem_PCA)
loadings(xylem_PCA)
```


adding height data
```{r}
library(austraits)

austraits <- load_austraits(version = "4.1.0", path = "data/austraits")

woody_data <- extract_trait(austraits, "woodiness")
woody_species <- woody_data$traits |> 
  filter(value == "woody") |> 
  distinct(taxon_name) |> 
  filter(!grepl(" sp.", taxon_name, fixed = T))

write.csv(woody_species, "data/woody_species.csv", row.names = F)

woody_families <- read.csv("data/austraits_woody_spp.csv", header = T)
woody_families_n <- woody_families |> group_by(family) |> summarise(n=n())

height_data <- extract_trait(austraits, "plant_height")

euc_heights <- height_data$traits |> 
  filter(taxon_name %in% xylem_Dh$apc_name) |> 
  filter(value_type == "maximum") |> 
  group_by(taxon_name) |> 
  summarise(max_height = max(value),
            mean_height = mean(value))

xylem_Dh_height <- xylem_Dh |> left_join(euc_heights, by = c("apc_name" = "taxon_name"))

# ggplot(data = xylem_Dh_height, aes(mean_MAP, mean_Dh/max_height)) +
  ggplot(data = xylem_Dh_height, aes(AI, max_height)) +
# ggplot(data = xylem_Dh_height, aes(max_height, mean_Dh)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() + 
  facet_wrap(~family)

```
